reviews.title: Excellent Easy to Use App
reviews.text:
I have been using the Protein Pal app for three weeks since I started on the Wegovy pills.  I ran it alongside another app during  their trial phase.  It was a simple choice of which one I wanted to keep.  PP is so much easier to use.  The main page is less cluttered with information I don’t care about.  I can easily take photos of the food and/or barcode and have a record of the day’s protein and calories. Too easy!

I sent in a request for a feature request and received a very nice personal response regarding it.  I couldn’t be happier with the app and service.

I would like to start tracking this stuff and don’t want to download another app just for it.

reviews.title: Wasn’t sure, but now I’m obsessed

My diet has completely changed overnight because tracking is so incredibly easy with the app. Feeling very excited about losing weight and changing my lifestyle- hoping I can get my husband to use it too.

reviews.title: limited if you don’t pay

Unless you pay, you can’t even look up an ingredient to track, it has to be free typed completely - the calorie and the protein. That kind of defeats the purpose as to why I even got the app. If i wanted to free type everything then I would just stick to my notes app and not have downloaded this to begin with. Waste of time.

The scan barcode feature is much more accurate than in other big diet and tracking apps I’ve used for years.

reviews.title: Ok but not great
reviews.text: App has some good features, but the biggest gaps are not being able to see sugars intake or other things like fiber, etc. Also the dog icon as the protein pal sends the wrong message. Is this for humans or pets? I don’t get it. I don’t like it. I’d also like to see something the includes weight and body composition tracking and somewhere to track workouts and sleep too, like a one stop shop. Without these things I wouldn’t renew this because I still have to use many trackers. It’s too much to manage without the value.
